title: Capture selected native execution closure into bounded evidence packs
outcome: Publish actual native historical execution records and their existing witnesses through the accepted evidence-pack owners, rather than only re-exporting previously retained packs.
acceptance: An explicit attributed service operation selects actual host-local native canonical execution/work/root records and existing governing/feed witnesses at a recorded cut, and constructs a closed bounded pack through the existing inventory/dependency and EvidencePack owners; record IDs, original bytes and links remain unchanged.

Prepared selection and pack identities are retained for exact retry; absent context, changed selection, unsupported kinds or limits refuse without partial pack publication. Imported records remain inert provenance and never become local execution authority.

Behavior tests cover a real native run/evidence closure, exact repeat, missing-context atomic refusal and a bounded continuation; hand off the exact checked patch/API to the parent. No new schema, merge engine, model calls or network/push authority.

completion.summary: Delivered bounded native evidence capture and retained whole-pack continuation, preserving original bytes and identities, with atomic refusals and inert imported history.
